units.source_text: 那时我也算成年人了，竟然还不懂为自己添些像样的衣服。

en.t: By then I was more or less an adult, yet I still did not know enough to buy myself decent clothes.

units.source_text: 因为，我莫名地认为，等到毕了业，可以留胡子的时候，再考虑衣服之类的事也不迟。

en.t: For some reason I thought it would be soon enough to worry about clothes after I graduated and reached the age when I could grow a beard.

units.source_text: 所以就对夫人说，我需要的是书籍，不需要衣服。

en.t: So I told the lady of the house that what I needed was books, not clothes.

units.source_text: 她知道我买了很多书，问我买的书都看了吗。

en.t: She knew that I bought many books, and asked whether I had read all the books I had bought.

units.source_text: 我买的书籍中有字典，当然也有些应该看的书，却连一页也没有翻开过，我理屈词穷了。

en.t: Among the books I bought were dictionaries, and of course there were books I ought to have read, but some I had not opened even to a single page, so I had no answer.

units.source_text: 我忽然意识到，假使要买什么不需要的东西的话，那么书籍啦，衣服啦，还不都一样。

en.t: It suddenly occurred to me that if I was going to buy things I did not need, then books and clothes were really no different.

units.source_text: 况且，我也正想以受到她们很多照顾为借口，给小姐买些她中意的腰带和布料什么的，

en.t: Besides, I had been looking for an excuse, since they had done so much for me, to buy the young lady some obi or cloth that she would like,

units.source_text: 于是便一并拜托夫人去买。

en.t: so I asked the lady of the house to take care of buying everything together.

units.source_text: 夫人不想自己一个人去买，硬要我也一起去，还说小姐也得跟着去。

en.t: The lady of the house did not want to go shopping by herself; she insisted that I come too, and said the young lady had to come along as well.

units.source_text: 我们这代人是呼吸着旧时代的空气长大的，不习惯身为学生同年轻女人一起去逛街。

en.t: People of our generation had grown up breathing the air of an older age, and as students we were not used to going about town with young women.

units.source_text: 比起现在来，当时的我，更是个因循守旧的人，所以多少有些踌躇，但还是硬着头皮出了门。

en.t: Compared with now, I was even more bound by old customs then, so I hesitated somewhat, but still forced myself to go out.

units.source_text: 小姐精心地打扮了一番，她那本来就很白皙的脸上又擦了一层厚厚的白粉，所以更引人侧目了。

en.t: The young lady had dressed herself with great care, and because she had put a thick layer of white powder on her already fair face, she drew even more attention.

units.source_text: 街上的行人无不盯着小姐看，而且看过小姐之后，又必定将视线移到我的脸上，我不由尴尬万分。

en.t: Everyone passing in the street stared at the young lady, and after looking at her they invariably shifted their gaze to my face, which made me terribly embarrassed.
